requirements.basis: Read the complete current case, author outline and requirements assignment. The plan covers reinforcement/preference learning, reward/evaluator design, data/engineering, reasoning and agent post-training through named public outputs. Sections6–7 distinguish person identity, professional role intervals, paper affiliation/publication dates and different time-bearing network edges. Explicitly separating coauthorship, project reuse, simultaneous employment and confirmed moves addresses the requested attribution and relationship boundaries. Geographic/organizational selection follows actual public material and leaves unsupported employment out of the confirmed-role table rather than filling it from paper authorship. The four required artifacts—dated people table, specialty/output matrix, team timeline and typed network—are planned, with section8 using them for capability combinations and public collaboration decisions. No private contacts, motives, compensation or unsupported ranking is proposed. The original Chinese long-research output,2022–cutoff historical focus and2026-11-09 evidence cutoff remain intact. This is an adequate requirements plan, not an approval of later identities, dates or research conclusions.
